svg.text: same start, same freeze — opposite verdict

g.text: Connected · Primary · UpToDate
writing happily; replicating to peers
t = 0 partition
same event — the winner can't tell yet that it is the winner
DRBD notices — same cost as the loser
< 1 s (RST) · ≈ 5.5 s (idle) · 6 s (active I/O)
I/O SUSPENDED — frozen too (briefly)
`quorum all` means the winner ALSO loses quorum-all → it freezes, then asks
fence-peer callout (resource-only)
DRBD spawns `bedrock-fence-peer`, then BLOCKS on its exit code
bedrock-d: netd says I am Leader (+ exclusive witness claim if even) →
verdict = WIN → handler exit 4
exit 4 = "peer is Outdated"
DRBD marks the peer Outdated → quorum is satisfied again →
I/O RESUMES · the arbiter keeps serving
Primary · UpToDate · sole writer
a NEW current-UUID is minted here — this is correct:
it records "I diverged from the outdated peer" so the resync knows the delta
heal: peer returns as Outdated
winner is SyncSource; UUID ancestry is clean (loser never minted)
Connected · UpToDate/UpToDate
replicated pair restored; no operator action
